_note: Every tunable knob. Sections are read by bot.py; unknown keys are ignored. Edit here, not in code.

loot._mortar_note: mortar base 0 until H-AIM has a ballistic solver: v2 aims flat, so a mortar is only a cook-off liability

fire._note: fire the slot-1 special only inside this fraction of its range

upgrades._note: H-UPG. Partial override of upgrades.DEFAULTS. regen_cycles 0.25 -> ~1.0 only once a retreat-and-heal routine (H-REG) is live. bias is additive ln-power, e.g. {"sensors": -0.04}.

perception._note: H-PER; all knobs and defaults are in percept.DEFAULTS. use_carve is off (neutral in the harness). hunt_auto learns drift toward us from re-acquisition errors (practice squads hunt us) and leaks to 0.

nav._note: grid is baked in navmap.bin (python3 tools/bake_nav.py); a different clearance_margin_m rebuilds at runtime (~2 s)

stealth._note: mode: off | hide_only (stand still near the zone goal) | near_threat (also creep on a near step/boost/jet sound) | always

engage._note: H-ENG/H-REG (engage.py). Only the knobs that matter most are listed; every other key defaults inside engage.PARAMS (python3 engage.py --dump-params). R = my effective HP / damage taken to kill the fight; 1.0 is a coin flip, 1.4 about 75-80% to win.

aim._note: H-AIM knobs; defaults live in aim.py / aimcore.py, partial overrides allowed. Spec: claude/h-aim-mov-spec.md section 9. enabled=false restores the v2 aim/fire.

move._note: H-MOV knobs. Strafe holds are in decisions of 0.1 s. strafe_enabled=false turns fight movement off.

zone._note: zone.py ZoneParams; partial overrides allowed. override_loot_urgency: 1=soon 2=go 3=critical. idle_goal: center|comfort
